title: Stealth and awareness
summary: Design and build record for opt-in stealth: per-observer, per-subject decaying awareness, notice rolls with light exposure, the SearchLastKnown tactic, Noticed message, UI readouts, phases and tests.
notes: Subsystem design doc under docs/design/ with a 'Status: phases A to D built, E proposed' line but no ADR Decision/Consequences structure. Competing signals: SPEC (Rust type and function signatures for Notice/Stealth/notices/Awareness/Noticed/Snapshot field, system-set ordering, required pure and headless test properties, cost bounds, section 12b recording the as-built contracts) versus DOC (prose rationale, risks, what stealth buys). Resolved to SPEC per the higher-precedence rule because it defines implementation contracts the engine must honor. Note sibling docs/design/fields.md was classified DOC; the synthesizer may want to treat docs/design/ consistently. Section 12b supersedes earlier sections where they differ (tier-1 names NoticeStats/StealthStats, memory on NoticeStats, notices does not take perception). Cross-ref 'ui.md' is cited by name only, likely docs/design/ui.md. Output filename uses a path-derived suffix instead of the SHA-256 hash because no shell was available to compute it, matching sibling outputs.
